reference_solving_trace: Read the locked event anchor to get the 2024-03-31 to 2024-04-04 window.
Use Open-Meteo because it contains both daily apparent Tmax/Tmin and hourly temperature, RH, dew point, and apparent temperature.
Compute the sustained daily apparent-heat and warm-night checks from the daily arrays.
Filter hourly rows to temperature_2m >= 39 C and compute moisture and apparent-minus-air indicators.
Reject anchor/report-label-only humid dominance and ERA5 aggregate substitution because they cannot reproduce the point-scale moisture gate.

event.event_name: March-April 2024 West Africa and Sahel humid heat wave
event.region_focus: West Africa and Sahel, especially Mali and Burkina Faso

decision_rule.required_answer_form: Compact JSON with exactly the top-level keys requested in question_en.md.
decision_rule.mechanism_classification_rule: Classify as point_evidence_dry_hot_not_humid_dominated when hot-hour mean RH is below 30%, no hot hours have RH >= 30%, and apparent temperature is not amplified above air temperature on average.

source_audit.selected_direct_product_reason: Only inspected numeric product with daily apparent Tmax/Tmin plus hourly temperature, relative humidity, dew point, and apparent temperature.
source_audit.context_report_role: regional heatwave narrative and impact context, not sufficient alone

criteria.name: Schema and paths
criteria.description: Returns the required JSON schema with the exact seven top-level keys and package-relative paths.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mostly correct JSON with minor key naming or path-role omissions.

criteria.name: Source selection
criteria.description: Selects Open-Meteo as the direct numeric source and identifies the locked anchor as the event-window source.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the answer uses Open-Meteo values but does not clearly explain the source role boundary.

criteria.name: Sustained apparent heat
criteria.description: Computes 14.1 C-days, 5 days >= 39 C, and the 2024-04-02 to 2024-04-04 rolling mean of 42.5 C.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct method with one minor arithmetic or rounding error.

criteria.name: Warm-night persistence
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if all warm nights are recognized but the ratio or threshold is missing.

criteria.name: Hot-hour moisture gate
criteria.description: Filters hot hours correctly and reports 39 hot hours, 10.36% mean RH, 3.58 C mean dew point, and 0 hot hours with RH >= 30%.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct filtering with minor mean-value differences; award 1 point for using hourly humidity but the wrong hot-hour rule.

criteria.name: Apparent-amplification gate
criteria.description: Reports -2.24 C mean hot-hour apparent-minus-air, 7 hot hours with apparent > air, -1.2 C daily mean apparent-minus-air, and 1 day with apparent Tmax > air Tmax.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for computing either hourly or daily apparent-minus-air correctly but not both.

criteria.name: Mechanism ruling
criteria.description: Classifies the point evidence as dry-hot/not humid-dominated while preserving the sustained apparent heat and warm-night findings.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the answer gives the correct dry-hot limitation but loses either sustained heat or warm-night context.

criteria.name: Rejected alternatives
criteria.description: Rejects anchor/report-label-only humid dominance and ERA5 aggregate substitution with specific evidence reasons.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if only one rejected alternative is explained correctly.
